newsitem.title: GERMANY: German grain intervention offers down on year ago.
newsitem.headline: German grain intervention offers down on year ago.

text.p: Sales offers into German grain intervention stores in the November-May 1996/97 season continued at the sluggish pace seen since the start of the campaign, figures from the state grain intervention board BLE showed on Monday.
Volumes on December 13 totalled 287,821 tonnes compared with 1,072,598 tonnes a year earlier.
The figure described volumes accepted, but not yet delivered to stores, by the close last Friday.
Market prices of grain were steady above intervention buying-in levels, especially in the western German region.
The December intervention buying-in price is 234.86 marks.
